title: Paul McCartney live: Ullevi Stadium, Gothenburg | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Ullevi Stadium in Gothenburg, Sweden, on 12 June 2004.

It was the ninth show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates in May and June 2004.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
